scripts.text:
[Payon Guide]
Welcome to the
mountain city of Payon.
If you're unfamiliar with this
area, I can help you find what
you're looking for around here.
scripts.translation:
[斐揚嚮導]
歡迎來到山城斐揚。
如果您不熟悉這一帶，我可以幫您找到您需要的地方。

scripts.text: City Guide
scripts.translation: 城市導覽

scripts.text: Remove Marks from Mini-Map
scripts.translation: 移除小地圖示記

scripts.text: Notice.
scripts.translation: 告示

scripts.translation: 取消

scripts.text:
[Payon Guide]
Please select
a location from
the following menu.
Would you like me
to mark locations
on your Mini-Map?
scripts.translation:
[斐揚嚮導]
請從以下選單中選擇一個地點。
需要我在小地圖上為您標記這些地點嗎？

scripts.text:
[Payon Guide]
Please select
a location from
the following menu.
scripts.translation:
[斐揚嚮導]
請從以下選單中選擇一個地點。

scripts.text:
[Payon Guide]
Please select
a location from
the following menu.
[Payon Guide]
The Archer Guild handles
Job Changes to the Archer
Class. You'll need to enter
the Archer Village which is
to the northeast of Payon.
scripts.translation:
[斐揚嚮導]
請從以下選單中選擇一個地點。
[斐揚嚮導]
弓箭手公會負責辦理弓箭手的轉職手續。
您需要前往斐揚東北方的弓箭手村。

scripts.text:
[Payon Guide]
Please select
a location from
the following menu.
[Payon Guide]
The Weapon Shop
can be found in the
northwest corner of
the city of Payon.
scripts.translation:
[斐揚嚮導]
請從以下選單中選擇一個地點。
[斐揚嚮導]
武器店位於斐揚城的西北角。

scripts.text:
[Payon Guide]
Please select
a location from
the following menu.
[Payon Guide]
The Tool Shop
is located near
the northwest
corner of Payon.
scripts.translation:
[斐揚嚮導]
請從以下選單中選擇一個地點。
[斐揚嚮導]
道具店位於斐揚城西北角附近。

scripts.text:
[Payon Guide]
Please select
a location from
the following menu.
[Payon Guide]
The Pub can be
found in the northeast
part of Payon. It's the
best place to relax after
a long day of hunting.
scripts.translation:
[斐揚嚮導]
請從以下選單中選擇一個地點。
[斐揚嚮導]
酒館位於斐揚東北部。
狩獵了一整天后，那裡是放鬆身心的最佳去處。

scripts.text:
[Payon Guide]
Please select
a location from
the following menu.
[Payon Guide]
The Central Palace
is located to the north
within the city of Payon.
scripts.translation:
[斐揚嚮導]
請從以下選單中選擇一個地點。
[斐揚嚮導]
中央宮位於斐揚城內的北部。

scripts.text:
[Payon Guide]
Please select
a location from
the following menu.
[Payon Guide]
The Empress
can be found to the
northwest in Payon.
scripts.translation:
[斐揚嚮導]
請從以下選單中選擇一個地點。
[斐揚嚮導]
您可以在斐揚西北部找到女皇。

scripts.text:
[Payon Guide]
Please select
a location from
the following menu.
[Payon Guide]
The Palace Annex
can be found in the

scripts.translation:

[斐揚嚮導]
宮殿附屬建築位於斐揚西部。

scripts.text:
[Payon Guide]
Please select
a location from
the following menu.
[Payon Guide]
The Royal Kitchen
is located near the
northern end of Payon.
scripts.translation:
[斐揚嚮導]
請從以下選單中選擇一個地點。
[斐揚嚮導]
皇家廚房位於斐揚北端附近。

scripts.text:
[Payon Guide]
Please select
a location from
the following menu.
[Payon Guide]
The Forge is
situated near
the center of Payon.
scripts.translation:
[斐揚嚮導]
請從以下選單中選擇一個地點。
[斐揚嚮導]
鍛造所位於斐揚市中心附近。

scripts.text:
[Payon Guide]
Please select
a location from
the following menu.
[Payon Guide]
Please ask me to ''Remove
Marks from Mini-Map'' if you
no longer wish to have the
location marks displayed
on your Mini-Map.
scripts.translation:
[斐揚嚮導]
請從以下選單中選擇一個地點。
[斐揚嚮導]
如果不想讓小地圖繼續顯示地點標記，請選擇“移除小地圖示記”。

scripts.text: Yes.
scripts.translation: 是

scripts.text: No.
scripts.translation: 否

scripts.text:
[Payon Guide]
Advances in sorcery and
technology have allowed
us to update our information
system, enabling up to mark
locations on your Mini-Map
for easier navigation.
scripts.translation:
[斐揚嚮導]
魔法與科技的進步讓我們得以更新資訊系統，現在可以在您的小地圖上標記地點，方便您辨認方向。

scripts.text:
[Payon Guide]
Your Mini-Map is located
in the upper right corner
of the screen. If you can't
see it, press the Ctrl + Tab
keys or click the ''Map'' button in your Basic Info Window.
scripts.translation:
[斐揚嚮導]
小地圖位於螢幕右上角。
如果看不到，請按Ctrl + Tab，或點選基本資訊視窗中的“地圖”按鈕。

scripts.text:
[Payon Guide]
On your Mini-Map,
click on the ''+'' and ''-''
symbols to zoom in and
our of your Mini-Map. We
hope you enjoy your travels
here in the city of Payon.
scripts.translation:
[斐揚嚮導]
點選小地圖上的“+”和“-”，就能放大或縮小地圖。
祝您在斐揚遊歷愉快。

scripts.text:
[Payon Guide]
Be safe in
your travels,
brave adventurer.
scripts.translation:
[斐揚嚮導]
勇敢的冒險者，祝您旅途平安。

scripts.text:

[斐揚嚮導]

[Payon Guide]
